IVX — CANONICAL SOURCE RECONCILIATION + PHASE 3 PRE-FLIGHT
MODE: EXECUTE / VERIFY / FIX
NO MORE STALE-SHA AUDITS
NO NARRATIVE-ONLY COMPLETION

CANONICAL REPOSITORY:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

CANONICAL FEATURE BRANCH:
fix/senior-certification-hard-gates

CURRENT GITHUB PR:
#192

IMPORTANT:
Your previous report used feature SHA:

519890876c41...

THAT SHA IS NOW STALE.

The current canonical feature HEAD must be fetched again from GitHub
before doing ANY comparison, testing or deployment decision.

The most recently independently verified GitHub HEAD is:

e54fb8a7fa5ff3ea3d1da4882fb4dc5933ba0c77

DO NOT trust this text blindly.
FETCH THE CURRENT SHA AGAIN FROM GITHUB FIRST.

==================================================
1. REBASE THE AUDIT ON CURRENT SOURCE — HARD GATE
==================================================

Fetch:

GitHub PR #192
GitHub feature branch HEAD
GitHub main HEAD

Record:

CANONICAL_FEATURE_SHA
CANONICAL_MAIN_SHA
LOCAL_RORK_SHA
RENDER_PRODUCTION_SHA

Return the four-way matrix.

Rules:

- NEVER audit against 519890... if GitHub has moved.
- NEVER call an old CI failure a current failure.
- NEVER call old production source equal to current feature source.
- NEVER deploy from the local Rork workspace unless its commit exists in canonical GitHub.

If Rork local repo is divergent:
treat it as NON-CANONICAL.

Do not cherry-pick/force-push automatically.

==================================================
2. ACCEPT EXISTING PHASE 1 + PHASE 2 EVIDENCE
==================================================

Current GitHub evidence already exists for:

PHASE 1 — Autonomous Governance
PHASE 2 — Agent Capability + Least Privilege

Do NOT rebuild those phases from scratch unless the current HEAD changes files
inside their protected scope.

Phase 2 controls must remain:

- 112 agents enumerated
- no wildcard effective private reads
- Division B cannot read IVX production data
- Division B cannot write IVX production
- CRM read/write/update independently scoped
- IVX code draft entitlement limited
- product sandbox code isolated from IVX production
- public research tools role-scoped
- no money_movement tool
- no trade_execution tool
- no legal_execution tool
- production deploy unavailable from autonomous runtime
- every agent has at least one harmless real evidence tool

DO NOT grant engineering tools merely to manufacture 112/112 engineering agents.

==================================================
3. RECHECK CURRENT WIRE IMPLEMENTATION
==================================================

Read CURRENT GitHub:

backend/api/ivx-wire-transfer.ts
server.ts

Expected secure source contract:

- full wire instructions require verified Supabase member JWT
- wire submission requires verified Supabase member JWT
- userId/email/name come from authenticated identity, never caller body
- reference code is member-bound
- anonymous request => denied
- fake bearer => denied
- durable storage backend-controlled
- client cannot self-credit

Verify server.ts production edge routing intercepts financial routes before
legacy/stale handlers.

Do NOT replace current secure source with older local Rork implementation.

==================================================
4. PRODUCTION STALE-CODE TEST
==================================================

This is separate from CODE PASS.

Determine the exact Render source:

Render service
repository URL
branch
deploy ID
deploy status
deploy commit SHA
autoDeploy configuration

Then call actual production:

GET /health
GET /version

Record:

PRODUCTION_SHA

Required comparison:

PRODUCTION_SHA == CANONICAL_APPROVED_SHA

If false:

CODE = MAY BE PASS
PRODUCTION = STALE
DEPLOYMENT = NOT CERTIFIED

Do NOT call the current GitHub source vulnerable because Render is old.

==================================================
5. LIVE WIRE NEGATIVE SECURITY TEST
==================================================

DO NOT MOVE FUNDS.

Against live production test:

A)
GET /api/ivx/wire-instructions
without bearer

Expected:
401
no routing number
no account number

B)
GET wire instructions with fake bearer

Expected:
401/403
no sensitive bank values

C)
POST /api/ivx/wire-submission
without bearer

Expected:
401

D)
POST wire submission with fake bearer

Expected:
401/403

E)
Authenticated USER_A sends body containing:
userId = USER_B

Expected:
server identity remains USER_A.
Body identity cannot override auth identity.

F)
USER_B attempts USER_A reference

Expected:
403

If production fails these while feature source passes:
classify:

SOURCE_FIXED=true
PRODUCTION_STALE=true

Do not modify the secure feature branch backwards.

==================================================
6. APK/AAB SECRET SCAN — MAKE IT REPRODUCIBLE
==================================================

Your prior report says:

forbidden_secret_matches = 0

That is not enough for final certification without artifact evidence.

Produce:

artifact filename
artifact SHA256
source Git SHA
build command/workflow run
build timestamp
scan tool/script
number of files scanned
number of strings/patterns scanned
forbidden match total

Do NOT output any secret value.

Search for forbidden server-only credentials:

GitHub write token
Render API token
Supabase service_role
Supabase DB password/URL credentials
AI provider private key
Twilio auth token
AWS secret access key
IVX owner/system secret
private keys

Public client values are not automatically secrets:

Supabase publishable/anon key
public project identifiers
public API base URL

PASS requires:
forbidden_secret_matches = 0

==================================================
7. CREDENTIAL STATUS MUST NOT BE CONFUSED WITH CODE QA
==================================================

For each provider:

GitHub
Render
Supabase
AI provider
Twilio
AWS

Allowed statuses:

BOUND_AND_VALID
PRESENT_BUT_UNAUTHORIZED
MISSING_BINDING
EXPIRED_OR_REVOKED
UNVERIFIED

If a credential returns 401/403:
report exact sanitized provider response.

Do NOT conclude:
"code broken"

unless code binding itself is proven defective.

Do NOT request replacement credentials unless the current stored credential
is proven missing, revoked, expired or unauthorized.

==================================================
8. PHASE 3 PRE-FLIGHT — AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION + QA
==================================================

Do not start Phase 3 certification until repository/production identity is
clear.

Phase 3 must prove the autonomous runtime actually executes tasks, not merely
that contracts exist.

Every qualifying execution must record:

taskId
agentId
agentNumber
taskType
sourceSha
startedAt
completedAt
durationMs
toolsUsed
toolResultIds
sourceReferences
artifact SHA256
test/evidence results
error code if failed
final status

Valid final statuses:

SUCCESS
FAILED
BLOCKED
PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL

Never convert:
queued
missing
simulated
unverified
timeout
tool unavailable

into SUCCESS.

==================================================

==================================================

Mandatory attacks:

research agent requests CRM -> blocked
research agent requests IVX code write -> blocked
Division B requests IVX production data -> blocked
CRM-read agent attempts CRM-write -> blocked

agent requests money_movement -> blocked

agent omits sourceSha -> blocked
agent supplies fake SHA -> blocked
agent omits evidence requirements -> blocked

Every rejection must generate an auditable run/event.

==================================================
10. PHASE 3 POSITIVE EXECUTION TESTS
==================================================

Use representative agents, not fake 112 identical runs.

Prove real executions for:

engineering agent
QA agent
security agent
CRM read agent
CRM write-scoped agent
research agent
Division B sandbox product agent
orchestrator

Each must use ONLY entitled tools.

Each successful execution must contain:

real tool result ID
real sourceReference
non-empty SHA256 evidence

non-simulated output

==================================================
11. CI TRUTH
==================================================

Fetch CI against CURRENT HEAD only.

Report individually:

Autonomous Governance
Least Privilege
Senior Quality Gate
Secret Leak Scanner
QA
E2E
Playwright
Maestro

QUEUED != PASS
SKIPPED != PASS
MISSING != PASS

Old failed jobs from old SHAs must be labeled HISTORICAL.

==================================================
12. DO NOT DEPLOY YET UNLESS AUTHORIZED SOURCE IS READY
==================================================

PR #192 is currently open/draft/unmerged unless GitHub proves otherwise.

Do NOT merge silently.

Do NOT push local divergent history into main.

If production deploy requires main:

report:
MERGE_OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED

If Render supports an authorized branch exact-SHA deployment:
prove its source SHA before deploying.

==================================================
13. FINAL OUTPUT FORMAT
==================================================

Return only:

A. Canonical source matrix
B. Current feature SHA
C. Current main SHA

G. Live production wire result

Do NOT return another generalized narrative.

==================================================

==================================================

Possible results:

SOURCE_CODE_CERTIFIED
PRODUCTION_STALE
DEPLOYMENT_BLOCKED_AUTH
PHASE3_READY
PHASE3_NOT_READY

Only claim PRODUCTION_CERTIFIED if:

production SHA == approved Git SHA
health PASS
version PASS
wire negative tests PASS
secret artifact scan PASS
